research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Shiru is researching structured protein particulates in fiber or sheet form that form oleogels and macrocolloids with improved thickening and stabilizing properties, as described in a disclosure on protein dry particulates. Another area involves climate change mitigation using oleogels prepared from plant proteins dispersed in oil phases. Additionally, Shiru is developing systems for identifying and developing food ingredients from natural sources using machine learning and in silico processes.

product.name: Flourish™ Platform
product.description: An AI, bioinformatics, and precision-biology platform for discovering natural proteins and ingredients with targeted functional properties.

product.name: Custom Ingredient Discovery
product.description: A collaborative ingredient-discovery service that identifies and validates proteins tailored to a company’s functional and commercial requirements.

product.name: OleoPro™
product.description: A protein-based structured fat alternative designed to replicate the functional properties of animal fats in food formulations.

product.name: uPro™
product.description: A texturizing protein for food formulations that helps provide structure and texture in products using plant-based or alternative ingredients.

product.name: C-OleoPro™
product.description: A protein-based emollient for skin and hair-care formulations, intended to provide sensory and conditioning functionality.

product.name: C-uPro™
product.description: An emulsifying protein ingredient for cosmetic formulations, designed to support the blending and stability of premium personal-care products.
